node.title: FPC5 Hankel split locators are an explicit guarded support-determinant system
node.statement: For every owner-free FPC5 Pade-Hankel cell, each locator recurrence is equivalent to vanishing of one printed generalized-Vandermonde determinant on the selected core roots and the weighted moment column. The punctured primitive pairing at root x_i equals w_i G'(x_i), where w_i is the unique Cramer amplitude of that support, so primitivity is exactly nonvanishing of all support-column Cramer minors. Thus guarded core-split locators are the symmetric quotient of one explicit quasi-affine determinantal incidence, with the remaining background Cauchy guards appended.
